name: My City Builders, Inc.
summary: My City Builders, Inc., together with its affiliated companies, is actively involved in the property market across the United States. The firm focuses on delivering housing solutions to individuals and families with lower incomes by acquiring, constructing, renting out, and selling residential properties. Prior to its current identity, the company operated as iMine Corporation, undergoing a name change to My City Builders, Inc. in April 2023. Established in 2022, its primary base of operations is located in Miami, Florida.
